title: Time-series analysis of three EBPR WWTP at Denmark Raw sequence reads
description: Saccharimonadia are globally distributed members of the Patescibacteria in wastewater treatment plants. To verify the correlation between an understudied lineage of Saccharimonadia and Phosphoribacter, we performed time-series amplicon sequencing using activated sludge samples from three different EBPR plants. We aimed at revealing the long-term coexistence and correlation between these two organisms. Sequencing was performed at the Joint Microbiome Facility of the Medical University of Vienna and the University of Vienna under the project ID JMF-2212-28.
